checked.description: False when no eval set was provided (contamination not assessed).
checked.title: Checked

contaminated.description: Training rows that also appear in the eval set.
contaminated.title: Contaminated

contaminated_rows.description: 0-based training-row indices found in the eval set.
contaminated_rows.title: Contaminated Rows

ngram_contaminated_rows.description: 0-based training-row indices flagged by n-gram/shingle overlap (>= overlap_threshold) rather than an exact hash match. Empty when method='exact' (the default). Rows already in contaminated_rows via exact match are not repeated here even under method='both'.
ngram_contaminated_rows.title: Ngram Contaminated Rows

minhash_contaminated_rows.description: 0-based training-row indices flagged by MinHash+LSH approximate Jaccard overlap (>= overlap_threshold) against the eval set. Populated only when method='minhash'; empty otherwise.
minhash_contaminated_rows.title: Minhash Contaminated Rows
